נניח והשיגורים אכן פסקו, וישראל תבליג על ההתעצמות של טרור זה רק כי התופעה ״נפסקה״, ותיתן ל״הסכם״ החדש להימשך כסדרו, זה אומר רק דבר אחד:

The official Syrian news agency, SANA, confirms the report of a meeting between a Syrian delegation headed by the Syrian Foreign Minister and a senior Israeli delegation today in Jordan, under American auspices.

According to the report, the meeting took place as part of efforts to de-escalate following the recent Israeli strikes on Syrian territory.

The discussions focused on formulating practical mechanisms to halt the Israeli strikes and on reviving the negotiation track with the aim of reaching a security agreement that could serve as a basis for a more comprehensive future agreement.

Syria reiterated its position that the occupied Golan is Syrian territory, but noted that at this stage it is still too early to discuss its final status and the path that will lead to that. The immediate priority is the withdrawal of Israeli forces to the lines where they were before December 8, 2024, and the full renewal of the implementation of the 1974 disengagement agreement.

The discussions also raised the importance of efforts to bridge the positions of Turkey and Israel and to ensure that the existing tensions between them do not spill over into Syrian territory.
